title: 这个笔记做完了，怎么导出来呢？在移动端

messages.content: 这个笔记做完了，怎么导出来呢？在移动端

更正一下：我前面提到的右上角「⋯」导出入口没有得到证实，手机端不一定有这个选项。

如果笔记页面里找不到导出或分享功能，可以把工作区同步到电脑，再从电脑端导出或处理 Markdown 文件。

An idea may begin as a sentence, a voice recording, a screenshot, or a link you do not have time to read yet. You should not have to choose a title, folder, and structure before saving it. NoteGen separates capturing from organizing. Save information as it appears. Later, select the records that belong together and organize them into a structured Markdown note. You can then review the result, add your own thinking, and continue writing. The goal is not to let AI write everything for you. It is to make sure useful fragments do not disappear before you have time to turn them into something complete. Capture what happened Save a thought, voice recording, screenshot, image, link, file, or todo while it is still fresh. Choose the material Filter records by tag, time, or type, then select the items that belong together. Organize the records Choose a template or describe what you want to write. NoteGen can organize the selected material into a summary, report, article, or another Markdown structure. Keep writing Review the draft in the editor, change the structure, add details, and continue writing in your own words. Record parts of a meeting, add two screenshots, and organize them into meeting notes afterward. Save links and reading fragments during the week, then organize them into a research note. Filter recent records by tag and prepare a weekly report without searching through several apps. Collect images and documents for a topic, then ask questions using those materials as context. Your written notes remain ordinary Markdown files in the workspace you choose. You can edit them with NoteGen, open them with another Markdown editor, keep them in Git, or move them without exporting from a proprietary format. NoteGen adds recording, AI, search, and organization around those files instead of replacing them. The editor supports: Tables, task lists, code blocks, math, diagrams, and document outlines Markdown source mode and visual editing Search and replace Images, attachments, links, and file references Export and printing tools File history and workspace management NoteGen connects to the AI providers and models you configure. You can use different models for chat, writing, embeddings, image recognition, OCR, and audio. AI can help you: Organize selected records into a structured note Continue, shorten, expand, rewrite, or translate existing text Ask questions about notes, records, images, and knowledge base content Search local material before answering Generate diagrams and charts from your notes Work through longer tasks with Agent mode AI is part of the workflow, but the result remains editable. You decide what to keep. A note should remain useful after you finish writing it. NoteGen can build a searchable knowledge base from your files and combine semantic retrieval with local text search. You can use a note, a group of records, or the knowledge base as context in a conversation instead of copying everything into a new prompt. For advanced workflows, NoteGen also supports: Vector indexing and hybrid retrieval Configurable embedding and reranking models Long-term memories and reusable prompts MCP servers Installable Skills Agent tools for working with notes and files NoteGen includes a canvas workspace for material that is easier to understand visually. You can create and edit: Flowcharts Mind maps Timelines Freehand drawings Data charts Diagrams generated from note content Canvas elements remain editable after they are created, including content suggested by AI. Notes are stored locally first. When you need them on another device, you can sync through services you already use. #### 一、文章结构梳理

​**​7. 四周行动计划​**​

#### 一、文章结构梳理

-   ​**​第一周​**​：建素材博物馆，列 5 个想研究的创作者，每天存一个好想法。
-   ​**​第二周​**​：找 3 个中等体量创作者拆解策略，每天围绕一个想法写 5 个角度，挑最好的发出去。
-   ​**​第三周​**​：继续发，重点看哪些帖子回复和提问最多。
-   ​**​第四周​**​：挑读者问得最多的问题，做一份免费指南收集邮箱，再扩展成付费产品。
-   ​**​接下来 12 个月​**​：持续做。

#### 二、值得反复看的观点金句

-   "没有人能跟一个拥有百万粉丝、过着遥不可及的奢华生活的人产生共鸣。大家更愿意跟着一个和自己处境差不多的人学东西。"
-   "网红为注意力优化，个人品牌为转化率优化，匠人一次只做一个想法、一个项目，然后让社交媒体来为它买单。"
-   "AI 复制不了你的认知系统，因为 AI 只能想别人让它想的东西。"
-   "没有人拥有一个话题，你只拥有你对这个话题的视角。"
-   "洗澡时冒出来的灵感，如果你相信自己能记住，午饭前它就不见了。"
-   "如果你想有别人没有的想法，你得去找别人不看的东西。"
-   "高熵的内容对人思考能力的破坏，比 AI 严重得多。"

这篇文章没有说什么颠覆性的新东西，但它把很多人隐约感觉到的事情串了起来：AI 在变强、热点在加速轮换、内容越来越同质化，在这个背景下，愿意慢慢做、围绕自己的观点持续积累的人，才有可能走得最远。

#### 四、一句话总结

* * *

#### 四、一句话总结

如果你正在做自媒体或者想搞点副业，这篇文章最实用的部分其实是"素材博物馆 + 五个角度"这套方法，不需要等灵感，直接按流程走就行。"},{"content":"#### 一、文章结构梳理

​**​1. 普通人正在悄悄赚到钱​**​ 没有百万粉丝的普通妈妈，靠一个简单的"30天挑战计划"数字产品就能做到百万美元收入。核心逻辑是：大家更愿意跟着和自己处境差不多、只领先一两步的人学东西，而不是遥不可及的超级网红。

#### 一、文章结构梳理

​**​2. 三种创作者，三条路​**​

#### 一、文章结构梳理

-   ​**​网红​**​：靠注意力吃饭，批量生产廉价多巴胺，内容被看后被忘掉。
-   ​**​个人品牌​**​：有产品和教育价值，但每条内容都是通往课程的漏斗，动作围着转化率和信任转。
-   ​**​匠人​**​：用社交媒体养活一个比自己活得更久的作品体系。关注度和收入是做好作品后自然跟过来的，不是每天要追的数字。

#### 一、文章结构梳理

​**​3. AI 时代，唯一的护城河是你的观点​**​ AI 十秒能写出 1500 个好看的字，但写不出你独特的人生经历塑造出来的那套看世界的方式。十个人聊同一个话题，只有一个人能换一种角度说出来，让人说"对，就是这个意思"。没有人拥有一个话题，你只拥有你对这个话题的视角。

#### 一、文章结构梳理

​**​4. 给自己建一个素材博物馆​**​ 长期做下去的创作者都有一个共同习惯：持续收集好想法和好素材。做法很简单——准备两个文件夹，一个放别人验证过数据好的素材，一个放你自己纯粹觉得说得好的想法。写内容时从两边各挑一个，融合自己的视角，就是好内容的起点。

#### 一、文章结构梳理

​**​5. 一个想法，五个角度​**​ 拿到想法不要急着写，先从五个方向过一遍：

#### 一、文章结构梳理

-   我喜欢的某个思想家会怎么说？
-   我会怎么跟过去的自己讲？
-   我能不能重新定义这个概念？
-   主流看法是什么，我哪里不同意？
-   这件事跟普通人有什么关系？

#### 一、文章结构梳理

​**​6. 爆款话题就是市场调研​**​ 最好卖的产品来自两个交集：人们已经在释放信号说他们想要什么 + 你自己已经解决过的问题。研究内容发现什么在爆，就是最好的市场调研。你的内容已经帮你筛选出了一批感兴趣的人，产品只是把他们聚到一起解决问题。

An idea may begin as a sentence, a voice recording, a screenshot, or a link you do not have time to read yet. You should not have to choose a title, folder, and structure before saving it. NoteGen separates capturing from organizing. Save information as it appears. Later, select the records that belong together and organize them into a structured Markdown note. You can then review the result, add your own thinking, and continue writing. The goal is not to let AI write everything for you. It is to make sure useful fragments do not disappear before you have time to turn them into something complete. Capture what happened Save a thought, voice recording, screenshot, image, link, file, or todo while it is still fresh. Choose the material Filter records by tag, time, or type, then select the items that belong together. Organize the records Choose a template or describe what you want to write. NoteGen can organize the selected material into a summary, report, article, or another Markdown structure. Keep writing Review the draft in the editor, change the structure, add details, and continue writing in your own words. Record parts of a meeting, add two screenshots, and organize them into meeting notes afterward. Save links and reading fragments during the week, then organize them into a research note. Filter recent records by tag and prepare a weekly report without searching through several apps. Collect images and documents for a topic, then ask questions using those materials as context. Your written notes remain ordinary Markdown files in the workspace you choose. You can edit them with NoteGen, open them with another Markdown editor, keep them in Git, or move them without exporting from a proprietary format. NoteGen adds recording, AI, search, and organization around those files instead of replacing them. The editor supports: Tables, task lists, code blocks, math, diagrams, and document outlines Markdown source mode and visual editing Search and replace Images, attachments, links, and file references Export and printing tools File history and workspace management NoteGen connects to the AI providers and models you configure. You can use different models for chat, writing, embeddings, image recognition, OCR, and audio. AI can help you: Organize selected records into a structured note Continue, shorten, expand, rewrite, or translate existing text Ask questions about notes, records, images, and knowledge base content Search local material before answering Generate diagrams and charts from your notes Work through longer tasks with Agent mode AI is part of the workflow, but the result remains editable. You decide what to keep. A note should remain useful after you finish writing it. NoteGen can build a searchable knowledge base from your files and combine semantic retrieval with local text search. You can use a note, a group of records, or the knowledge base as context in a conversation instead of copying everything into a new prompt. For advanced workflows, NoteGen also supports: Vector indexing and hybrid retrieval Configurable embedding and reranking models Long-term memories and reusable prompts MCP servers Installable Skills Agent tools for working with notes and files NoteGen includes a canvas workspace for material that is easier to understand visually. You can create and edit: Flowcharts Mind maps Timelines Freehand drawings Data charts Diagrams generated from note content Canvas elements remain editable after they are created, including content suggested by AI. -   ​**​第二周​**​：找 3 个中等体量创作者拆解策略，每天围绕一个想法写 5 个角度，挑最好的发出去。
-   ​**​第三周​**​：继续发，重点看哪些帖子回复和提问最多。
-   ​**​第四周​**​：挑读者问得最多的问题，做一份免费指南收集邮箱，再扩展成付费产品。
-   ​**​接下来 12 个月​**​：持续做。

#### 二、值得反复看的观点金句

-   "没有人能跟一个拥有百万粉丝、过着遥不可及的奢华生活的人产生共鸣。大家更愿意跟着一个和自己处境差不多的人学东西。"

-   "没有人拥有一个话题，你只拥有你对这个话题的视角。"

-   "如果你想有别人没有的想法，你得去找别人不看的东西。"
-   "高熵的内容对人思考能力的破坏，比 AI 严重得多。"

#### 一、文章结构梳理

#### 一、文章结构梳理

```markdown
# 我的笔记

```
